name: Cafe Gröfler
kurzbeschreibung:
**Café Gröfler in Uttendorf**

Welcome to **Café Gröfler**, a cozy gem nestled in the heart of **Uttendorf**, where traditional Tyrolean charm meets modern comfort. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming café invites you to savor the finest local flavors in a warm, rustic setting.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized layers of pancake torn into tender pieces, served with fresh fruit compote and a dusting of powdered sugar. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Melange** or a frothy **Einspänner**, and let the sweet aroma of freshly ground coffee fill the air.

For those craving something heartier, our menu features hearty **Kaspressknödel** (cheese dumplings) and crispy **Speckknödel**, paired with savory sauces and seasonal sides. Don’t miss our **Apfelstrudel**, baked to golden perfection with a hint of cinnamon and raisins—pure comfort in every bite.

The café’s sunny terrace offers a picturesque view of the surrounding **Zillertal** Alps, making it the perfect spot for a leisurely breakfast or an afternoon break. Whether you’re exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes or seeking a moment of relaxation, **Café Gröfler** promises an authentic taste of Tyrolean hospitality.

Come as you are—whether you’re a local or a visitor—every guest is welcome here. We look forward to serving you!
